title: supabaseCollectionOptions()
description: Builds the configuration for a TanStack DB collection backed by a Postgres table. Pass the result to `createCollection()` from `@tanstack/react-db`.

params.name: tableName
params.description: The Postgres table this collection reads from and writes to.

params.name: keys
params.description: The primary key column or columns for the table. Must match the table's primary key.

params.name: schema
params.description: A schema used to validate and type each row. Works with any [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev) library, such as Zod or Valibot.

params.name: supabase
params.description: The Supabase client instance to query and subscribe through.

params.name: queryClient
params.description: An existing TanStack Query client to share, if you already use one. If omitted, a shared global client is used.

params.name: realtime
params.description: Keep the collection in sync across clients using Supabase Realtime. Defaults to `false`.

params.name: realtimeUseFilter
params.description: Experimental. Apply server-side filtering to Realtime updates instead of filtering on the client. Only applies when `realtime` is `true`. Queries that can't be expressed as a Realtime filter, like `or(...)`, fall back to the unfiltered subscription. Defaults to `false`.

notes:
- To receive changes from other clients, enable Realtime for the table in the Table Editor, or run `alter publication supabase_realtime add table todos;`.
- Create one collection per table.
- Reads page past your project's max rows setting automatically. The default is 1000 rows. If a collection can grow past it, order by a unique column so pages stay consistent.
